name: Chiteki Shoujo -Lewd Student Council President-
original_name: 痴的少女 -Lewd Student Council President-
source:
It was the height of summer. Rikuo Tanaka (protagonist) was riding a train to school when a glamorous girl came up and started to molest his body. It seemed to be a reversal of train assault...

That was the first day going to a new school. From then on, it only got more amazing. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE073071.html]DLsite English[/url]]
